name: Can a Garage Conversion ADU Have a Full Kitchen and Bathroom?

mainEntity.name: Can a garage conversion ADU include a full kitchen and bathroom in Los Angeles County?
mainEntity.text: Can a garage conversion ADU include a full kitchen and bathroom in Los Angeles County?

acceptedAnswer.text: A garage conversion ADU can typically include a full kitchen and bathroom, but the conversion must be designed as a complete habitable unit rather than a simple storage change. That means the structure often needs insulation, drywall, heating and cooling, proper egress, plumbing, electrical upgrades, and fire separation improvements. The slab, walls, and roof may also need repairs or reinforcement depending on the existing garage condition. Because a kitchen and bathroom add plumbing, ventilation, and electrical demand, utility planning is one of the most important parts of the project. A contractor should inspect the garage early to determine whether the conversion is structurally and mechanically practical. Garage conversions are often attractive because they can be more cost-effective than detached new construction, but the finished design still needs to function like a real dwelling unit. Good planning helps avoid a cramped or code-challenged layout and makes the unit more usable and marketable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a garage conversion ADU can include a full kitchen and bathroom if the design meets applicable code, utility, and space requirements. The existing garage structure may need insulation, fire separation, upgraded electrical, plumbing, and ventilation to support habitable use.
